name: Sash Zats
bio: Sash has been a software engineer at Meta for 6 years, working on a broad range of projects from Facebook NewsFeed, Origami design macOS app, to android OS, <redacted> hardware, prototyping for brain-computer interfaces, and now blockchain on Instagram. Some say Sash has commitment issues, to which Sash says you are not my therapist. He values curiosity, strong opinions weakly held, and life-long learning.
